title: Summer 1 unit quizzes: photosynthesis, salts and energy (3 × 10 marks)
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 127 (Summer 1 unit quizzes: biology, chemistry, physics (10 marks each) and mark schemes (portal))
intro: Lesson 127. Own 4SD0-style questions. 10 minutes for each quiz. Show working and units.

questions.q: Write the balanced symbol equation for photosynthesis.
Name three factors that can limit the rate of photosynthesis.
questions.a: Light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, temperature

questions.q: Explain why the rate of photosynthesis falls above about 40 °C.
questions.a: Enzymes denature (1), so the reactions slow (1)

questions.q: Describe how leaf discs show the rate of photosynthesis.
questions.a: Oxygen made fills the air spaces (1), so discs float (1); time for discs to float measures the rate (1)

questions.q: Name the salt made when sulfuric acid reacts with copper oxide.
Write the word equation for calcium carbonate reacting with hydrochloric acid.
questions.a: Calcium carbonate + hydrochloric acid → calcium chloride + water + carbon dioxide

questions.q: Are these soluble or insoluble: sodium chloride, silver chloride, barium sulfate?
Describe the test for chloride ions.
questions.a: Add dilute nitric acid then silver nitrate solution (1); a white precipitate (1)

questions.q: What flame colour do potassium ions give?
A 2 kg ball falls 5 m. Calculate the GPE it loses (g = 10 N/kg).
A 0.5 kg ball moves at 4 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy.
A motor does 1,200 J of work in 20 s. Calculate its power.
A lamp takes in 200 J and gives out 50 J of light. Calculate its efficiency.
Explain how loft insulation reduces energy transfer.
questions.a: Traps air, a poor conductor (1), reducing conduction and convection (1)
